title: Baer's ideal-extension criterion for injectivity
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $J$ an $A$-module, in a common universe. Use the abelian category of $A$-modules [lem-weil-pbc-ring-modules-enough-injectives]. The module $J$ is injective [def-sp-injective-resolutions], meaning that for every inclusion $M\hookrightarrow N$ of $A$-modules every $A$-linear map $M\to J$ extends to $N$, if and only if every $A$-linear map $I\to J$ from an ideal $I\subseteq A$ extends to an $A$-linear map $A\to J$.
